title: TEST · The Torn Rule · Part 1
idea: At 3:07 am every phone in the city gets the same four rules, but rule three arrives torn in half and your neighbors somehow know the rest; every light goes dark except a fox's lantern on a roof, your neighbors stand at their windows staring at your door, three knocks, and a deep voice says rule three means you let them in.
